questions.question: Write 2:15 p.m. and 9:45 p.m. in 24-hour time. Explain how.
questions.expected_answer: For times after noon, add 12 to the hour. So 2:15 p.m. is 14:15 and 9:45 p.m. is 21:45.

questions.question: Write 00:30 in 12-hour time and explain why.
questions.expected_answer: 00:30 is 30 minutes after midnight. In 12-hour time, the hour after midnight is called 12, so it is 12:30 a.m.

questions.question: A stopwatch shows 01:05,32. How long is that?
questions.expected_answer: It is 1 minute, 5 seconds and 32 hundredths of a second. Since 1 minute is 60 seconds, that is 65,32 seconds.
